top_signals.title: U.S. to put missile system on island near Taiwan for drills
top_signals.summary: The U.S. military is set to deploy an advanced anti-ship missile system to Yonaguni for the first time for drills later this month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Stocks Rise As Jobs Report Eases Fed-Hike Worries
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Chris Phelan CEA Chairman, Robert Reich, Former US Labor Secretary, Alex Straton, Morgan Stanley Equity Research Managing Director,  Gary Marcus, Robust AI Inc. CEO&Founder, Veronica Willis is an Investment Strategy Analyst, Dr Cecilia Elena Rouse, The President of Brookings Institution, Atsi Sheth, Moody’s Chief Credit Officer, Brendan McKenna, Societe Generale Emerging Markets Strategist (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Ethereum Foundation launches zkAPI to let users pay for AI models without revealing identity
top_signals.summary: Users deposit funds into an Ethereum vault and authorize spending with zero-knowledge proofs, so the API provider can't link requests to a payer.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
